name: sportx-monorepo
description: SportX — Unified Monorepo (Frontend + Express API Backend)

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm --prefix backend/functions run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend/functions && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd backend/functions && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
